data.name: Kuraybah
data.long_meaning:
A warrior who remains unknown in battle.
Derived from the Arabic root 'krb', meaning 'to hide'.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes bravery and anonymity, evoking the spirit of warriors who fought in the name of Allah.

in_arabic.name: كريبة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني قريبة أو ذات قرابة، مؤنث من قرب
in_arabic.long_meaning: كريبة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة قرب، يعني قريبة أو ذات قرابة. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى الشخصية القريبة من القلب أو ذات الصلة القريبة. وفي سياق التسمية الإسلامية، قد يُعطى هذا الاسم للمولودات اللاتي يعتبرن قريبات من الله أو ذوات صلة وثيقة بالدين الإسلامي.

in_urdu.name: کریبة
in_urdu.meaning: نام مطلب قریبی یا رشتے کی ملکیات، عربی ಮೂಲ کا اسم
in_urdu.long_meaning: کریبة ایک عربی मूल کا اسم ہے جس کا مطلب ہے قریبی یا رشتے کی ملکیات۔ یہ نام ان لڑکیوں کو دیا جاتا ہے جو دل کے قریب یا ذاتی تعلقات میں شمار ہوتی ہیں۔ اسلامی تسمین کے تناظر میں، یہ نام ان بچوں کے لیے منتخب کیا جاتا ہے جو اللہ کے قریب یا اسلام کے ساتھ گہرا تعلق رکھتی ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: करीबा
in_hindi.meaning: करीबी या रिश्तेदारी की विशेषता, अरबी मूल का नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: करीबा एक अरबी मूल का नाम है जिसका अर्थ है करीबी या रिश्तेदारी की विशेषता। यह नाम उन लड़कियों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो दिल के करीब या व्यक्तिगत संबंधों में मानी जाती हैं। इस्लामी नामकरण परंपरा में, यह नाम उन बच्चों के लिए चुना जाता है जो ईश्वर के करीब या इस्लाम के साथ घनिष्ठ संबंध रखती हैं।

in_english.name: Kuraybah
in_english.meaning: Means 'close one' or 'relative', derived from Arabic root
in_english.long_meaning: Kuraybah is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic root 'q-r-b', meaning 'close one' or 'relative'. In Islamic tradition, the name signifies a person who is close to God or has a strong bond with the Islamic faith. The name reflects a sense of proximity and affection, making it a meaningful choice for Muslim parents. Historically, the name has been used in various Muslim cultures, symbolizing spiritual closeness and familial ties.

data.cultural_impact: In the early Islamic civilization, warriors played a pivotal role in defending the Muslim community against enemies. Kuraybah, as a warrior name, would have been highly valued among Muslim communities. The name suggests a brave and courageous individual who distinguished himself in battle, but effectively remained hidden and unidentified by the enemy due to his exceptional skills and strategic positioning. This name likely held significant cultural appeal for the Muslim tribe members, who would have seen it as a source of pride that one of their own was a skilled and unconquerable warrior.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Kuraybah may be seen as a symbol of humility and selflessness, representing the idea of serving a greater purpose without seeking personal recognition or worldly rewards. In Islamic teachings, warriors who dedicate their lives to defending their community and protecting the faith are considered to be serving Allah and fulfilling their duty as Muslims. Kuraybah, the warrior who remains unknown, embodies this selfless and noble spirit, focusing on the battle at hand and not seeking personal recognition for his actions. This spiritual significance would have resonated deeply with the Muslim communities who gave this name to their sons and fellows warriors, inspiring them to serve Allah and their community with the same unwavering courage and humility.
